# ghost_licenses (Data Source)

Lists the licenses Ghost offers, the values `ghost_repository`'s `license_template` takes, and optionally reads one license's details and text with `key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every license, the keys ghost_repository's license_template takes.
data "ghost_licenses" "all" {}

# One license and its text. Keys are matched case-insensitively, so an SPDX
# ID works too: license.key is Ghost's key, "apache-2.0".
data "ghost_licenses" "apache" {
  key = "Apache-2.0"
}

resource "ghost_repository" "example" {
  name             = "example"
  auto_init        = true
  license_template = data.ghost_licenses.apache.license.key
}

output "license_names" {
  value = { for l in data.ghost_licenses.all.licenses : l.key => l.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `key` (String) A license to read into `license`, e.g. `mit`. Ghost matches it case-insensitively, so an SPDX ID such as `MIT` or `Apache-2.0` works too. Omit it to only list the licenses.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `licenses`.
- `keys` (List of String) The key of every license, in Ghost's order (sorted by key).
- `license` (Attributes) The license named by `key`; null when `key` isn't set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--license))
- `licenses` (Attributes List) Every license, in the same order as `keys`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--licenses))

<a id="nestedatt--license"></a>
### Nested Schema for `license`

Read-Only:

- `body` (String) The license text. A repository created with this `license_template` (and `auto_init`) starts with it as its `LICENSE`, with `[year]` replaced by the current year and `[fullname]` by the owner's name.
- `conditions` (List of String) What the license requires, e.g. `include-copyright`.
- `description` (String) A short summary of the license.
- `featured` (Boolean) Whether Ghost features the license (`mit`, `apache-2.0` and `gpl-3.0`).
- `html_url` (String) The license's page on choosealicense.com.
- `implementation` (String) How to apply the license to a project.
- `key` (String) Ghost's lower-case key, which may differ in case from `key`.
- `limitations` (List of String) What the license limits, e.g. `liability`.
- `name` (String) The license's full name.
- `permissions` (List of String) What the license permits, as choosealicense.com rule tags, e.g. `commercial-use`.
- `spdx_id` (String) The license's SPDX identifier.


<a id="nestedatt--licenses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `licenses`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The lower-case key `license_template` takes, e.g. `apache-2.0`.
- `name` (String) The license's full name, e.g. `Apache License 2.0`.
- `spdx_id` (String) The license's SPDX identifier, e.g. `Apache-2.0`.
